jobs.title: Senior FP&A AI Transformation Analyst
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
As a Senior FP&A AI Transformation Analyst, you will help improve and modernize financial planning and analysis processes applying automation, digital technologies and AI-powered solutions. You will partner with finance teams and stakeholders across global regions to identify opportunities to simplify work, improve reporting quality, and increase operational efficiency.
You will be part of the Global Analytics & Insights organization and report to the Manager, Global Analytics & Insights. You will follow a hybrid work model, with three days per week in the Katowice office and two days working remotely.

Your Responsibilities:
- Lead finance transformation projects that improve FP&A processes, reporting, and operational efficiency through automation and digital tools.
- Partner with FP&A teams and business stakeholders to identify process improvement opportunities and translate requirements into practical solutions.
- Develop and enhance financial reporting, dashboards, and automated workflows that support business decision-making.
- Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, root causes, data quality issues, and opportunities for process standardization.
- Manage project activities from planning through implementation, including priorities, timelines, risks, stakeholder alignment, and change adoption.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- Experience in FP&A, financial reporting, finance transformation, process improvement, or related finance responsibilities.
- Experience working with financial data, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or financial analysis processes.
- Experience using Microsoft Excel and reporting or automation tools to improve business processes.
- Partnership experience with stakeholders across departments and translate requirements into scalable solutions.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:
- 3+ years of experience in FP&A, finance transformation, financial systems, automation, or business process improvement.
- Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, or similar digital tools.
- Experience supporting finance process standardization or transformation projects in a global organization.
- Knowledge of planning, forecasting, management reporting, and performance management processes.
- Experience working with AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve finance processes and productivity.
- Experience managing projects or workstreams with multiple stakeholders.

What We Offer:
- Medical Plan - Includes coverage for partners and children. Paid by Rockwell, subject to tax and social security contributions payable by you.
- Medicover Sport Program - Includes a sports card with weekly entries to sports, recreation and wellbeing facilities within the Medicover network.
- Pension Scheme - Participation in Employee Capital Plans (PPK), a voluntary long-term retirement savings program provided in accordance with statutory requirements.
- Life insurance - Group life insurance, including disability coverage. Paid by Rockwell, subject to tax and social security contributions payable by you.
- MyBenefit Platform - Access to a flexible benefits platform, with monthly points allocated by the employer.
- Lunch Card – Monthly meal vouchers through the Edenred card.
- OnTrack - A wellbeing platform that encourages movement and healthy habits.
- Employee Assistance Program - Access to personal coaching and resources to support physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing goals.
- Calm Premium - Tools for relaxation, meditation, focus and sleep.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Analyst Treasury, EMEA
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
As a Treasury Analyst, EMEA, you will support treasury operations across the EMEA region and report directly to the EMEA Treasury Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional to gain hands-on experience in cash management, banking operations, liquidity management, forecasting, and treasury administration within a global organization.

You will become part of a small, experienced and collaborative Treasury team that helps support Rockwell Automation's ongoing journey toward an outstanding organization.

You will work with diverse internal teams, external bank partners and have exposure to a broad range of treasury activities across multiple countries.

In addition to supporting EMEA treasury activities, you will collaborate with Treasury colleagues in the United States and China. This international environment provides the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, develop new skills and build meaningful relationships across the organization.

We are looking for someone curious and passionate about improving processes through technology and automation.

If you are looking for a role where you can grow within a high-performing team that values collaboration and new ideas we encourage you to apply.

Location : Katowice, Poland - Hybrid

Work Hours: from 9 to 5 PM CET

Your Responsibilities:

- General - Monitor EMEA Treasury email inbox, handle questions and communicate with EMEA Manager to resolve queries
- Input EMEA guarantee requests in bank portal and follow up on bank execution

- Liquidity - Monitor cash threshold at stand alone bank accounts. Estimate funding needs, initiate funding wires
- Monitor daily account balance thresholds at different EMEA entities, prepare funding recommendations, and initiate funding transfers
- Initiate manual cash concentration and ad hoc cash pool wires

- Forecasting: - Obtain and summarize daily regional funding requests (AP, payroll, taxes, and others)
- Update global cash pool forecast with EMEA & Asia Pacific funding needs
- Update cash forecasts, estimate funding needs and initiate funding transfers

- Static data: - Maintain electronic users and signatories at diverse EMEA bank portals

- Bank account: - Support bank account opening and closing; coordinate signatory updates and EMEA mandate reviews
- Handle bank compliance requests (KYC, FATCA, risk and sanctioned countries)

- Intercompany: - Update monthly principal/commissionaire intercompany balance overview, coordinate settlements
- Prepare EMEA intercompany monthly summary, update FX requests overview and coordinate execution

- Improvements/projects / backup - Support ad hoc Treasury projects (cash pooling, banking connectivity, TMS)
- Contribute to the development of treasury reports and process improvements
- Be a back up for USA-based Treasury analysts

The Essentials - You Will Have:

- A bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics or related field
- Up to 3 years of work experience preferably in Treasury; or Finance and Controlling

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

- Experience with treasury systems or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP)
- Familiarity with data analysis
- Committed to process improvements
- Fluent command of English
- Availiability to work from 9 to 5 pm CET

What We Offer:

Our benefits package includes …

- Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
- Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
- On-demand digital course library for professional development
- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
- Employee Assistance Program
- Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

... and other local benefits!

jobs.title: Security Operations Lead & Assistant Facility Security Officer (AFSO)
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
The Security Operations Lead and Assistant Facility Security Officer (AFSO) supports our physical security operations, executive protection program, and industrial security compliance. This role partners with the Director, Industrial Security & Global Security Operations to safeguard personnel, facilities, assets, and sensitive programs through security governance, operational execution, and continuous improvement.
Under the direction of the Director, Industrial Security & Global Security Operations you'll work from our Milwaukee, WI Global HQ in a hybrid schedule.

Your Responsibilities:
Industrial Security & AFSO Responsibilities
- Be an Assistant FSO for a non-possessing facility, partnering with the FSO to administer our Industrial Security Program following NISPOM requirements.
- Process and manage personnel security clearance activities, including submissions, onboarding, and debriefings.
- Support classified contract execution by helping ensure applicable security requirements are implemented and maintained.
- Maintain required industrial security documentation, including training records, DD254s, and materials needed for DCSA reviews, self-inspections, and internal audits.
- Monitor evolving government security requirements and benchmark with the industrial security community to recommend process improvements to strengthen and support a mature, compliant, and industry-aligned industrial security program.

Global Security Program Support
- Support Global Security Program administration, including documentation, KPI tracking, provider coordination, benchmarking, and program improvement efforts relating to executive protection, crisis management, and threat assessment, among other aspects of the program.
- Participate in routine and ad hoc meetings with other teams, partners, and vendors to manage projects, identify program enhancements, and support modernization or automation opportunities.
- Lead different security projects, crisis management initiatives, and other Global Security program responsibilities as assigned.

Physical Security Systems
- Support enterprise physical security systems strategy, including access control, video management, benchmarking, administration, modernization, and enhancement initiatives.
- Partner with the Global Security Systems Lead and security systems personnel to identify and mitigate issues, track system health, maintain accurate inventory, and report operational metrics.
- Help with the design, implementation, and project management of physical security systems across company locations.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
- Bachelor's degree
- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
- The ability to travel 10% of the time.
- A valid drivers license.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:
- 3+ years of relevant government experience or 5+ years of security industry experience
- Active Top-Secret eligibility or the ability to obtain post-employment.
- Experience managing sensitive documentation and working within compliance-driven deadlines
- Experience in government with a solid network of contacts.
- Working knowledge of the National Industrial Security Program (NISPOM) and DCSA assessments.
- Experience managing physical security systems (e.g., access control, video management) at a multi-site organization.
- Executive Protection experience or training.

What We Offer:
- Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
- 401k
- Paid Time off
- Parental and Caregiver Leave
- Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
- To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www. raquickfind.com .
